Definition: of Hebrew origin (H669 or better H6085); Ephraim, a place in Palestine:--Ephraim.
BiblicalUsage: Ephraim is the city where Jesus went when the chief priests plotted to kill Him — a city near the wilderness, where He continued with His disciples until the Passover drew near. The place bears the patriarch's name, and for a little while it sheltered the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: When the plot closed in, Jesus withdrew to a small city, and even the withdrawal was part of the road to the cross. I believe Ephraim's quiet role matters because it shows the Lord choosing the unnoticed place to wait for the appointed hour.
